description: Use this skill to build or configure a multi-vehicle aerospace simulation in Simulink with Aerospace Blockset system-level actor models and mission planning functions: fleet simulations, multi-UAV missions, formation flights, search and rescue missions, coordinated aircraft and ship scenarios, or any model where several vehicles share one scene. Also use it to plan a mission or generate trajectories with Aero.trajectory functions (waypoints, search patterns, loiters, transits) or to configure Kinematic Aerospace Actor blocks, even when the request does not say "multi-vehicle". The skill covers scene setup, trajectory generation, coordination logic, architecture decomposition, and coordinate frame consistency. Requires MATLAB R2026b or later.
